legend: This lesion appears overtly malignant. There is a diffuse infiltrate of medium to large lympohocytes.

diagnosis: Intestinal T-cell lymphoma NOS involving the stomach
legend: A dense lymphoid infiltrate is seen in the lamina propria, interdigitating between the gastric glands (shown here). The infiltrate is composed of medium-sized to large pleomorphic lymphocytes, which have dispersed chromatin and prominent nucleoli (Fig. <<44659>>). The neoplastic cells are diffusely positive for CD4 (Fig. <<44661>>), lack CD8 expression (Fig. <<44662>>), and display strong CD30 expression (Fig. <<44663>>). The neoplastic cells are also positive for granzyme B, indicating a cytotoxic phenotype (Fig. <<44664>>).
